intake.goal: Draft an external email to Acme Cloud operations about a sensitive EU runtime incident and request specific verification steps and a status update within 60 minutes.
intake.context: A sensitive runtime incident affecting the EU customer notification pipeline was detected at 09:12 CET on May 25, 2026. It caused intermittent delivery failures for transactional notifications and is still under investigation. No confirmed data loss, but delayed processing occurred for some EU tenants. Prefer referencing official EU sources.
intake.domain_label: External incident notification email to operations (EU notification pipeline)
success_criteria: Email clearly states the incident timeline and current status (still investigating, no confirmed data loss)
Email requests all specified verification actions (delivery queues, retry backlog, extended impact assessment)
Email includes a 60-minute status update request to the incident lead
Tone and wording are appropriate for a sensitive incident and avoid unconfirmed claims
constraints: Email is addressed to the operations team at Acme Cloud

Incident details: detected 09:12 CET, May 25, 2026; intermittent delivery failures for transactional notifications; still under investigation; no confirmed data loss; delayed processing for some EU tenants
Ask operations to manually verify delivery queues
Ask operations to check retry backlog
Ask operations to confirm whether customer-facing impact extended beyond the notification pipeline
Request status back to the incident lead within 60 minutes
Do not claim confirmed data loss or fully characterized impact beyond what is provided

planner_rationale: Create a sensitive, externally appropriate incident notification email to Acme Cloud operations that accurately reflects the EU runtime incident timeline and current understanding, requests concrete verification actions (delivery queues and retry backlog), clarifies what is unconfirmed (scope beyond the EU notification pipeline), and sets a clear deadline for a status update back to the incident lead within 60 minutes, while avoiding claims of confirmed data loss or fully characterized impact.

plan_steps.objective: Define the email’s core incident facts and guardrails to ensure accuracy and avoid unconfirmed assertions.
plan_steps.rationale: The email must be trusted and actionable; high-sensitivity context requires strict adherence to provided facts (intermittent delivery failures, still investigating, no confirmed data loss, delayed processing for some EU tenants) and avoid overstating impact.
plan_steps.expected_outcome: A compact factual summary ready to be incorporated into the email: detection time (09:12 CET, May 25, 2026), affected component (EU customer notification pipeline), observed symptoms (intermittent delivery failures for transactional notifications; delayed processing for some EU tenants), current status (under investigation), and confirmed scope limits (no confirmed data loss; extended impact unconfirmed).

plan_steps.objective: Translate the operational verification needs into explicit, requestable actions for the Acme operations team.
plan_steps.rationale: Operations can move quickly if the requested checks are specific and unambiguous; the constraints require manual verification of delivery queues and inspection of the retry backlog.
plan_steps.expected_outcome: A checklist-style set of requested actions to include in the email: (1) manual verification of relevant delivery queues for EU transactional notifications during the incident window, and (2) review/assessment of the retry backlog (size, growth trend, current drain rate, and any failures/errors indicating where messages are accumulating).

plan_steps.objective: Add a targeted request to determine whether impact exceeded the notification pipeline, without claiming completeness.
plan_steps.rationale: The email must ask operations to confirm extended customer-facing impact beyond the notification pipeline, while clearly stating that this is not yet confirmed and should be investigated/validated.
plan_steps.expected_outcome: A precise question section for operations to answer: whether any customer-facing effects extended beyond the notification pipeline (e.g., downstream systems or other notification channels), with wording that frames it as verification rather than assertion.

plan_steps.objective: Set a time-bound status update requirement to the incident lead and specify what “status” should include.
plan_steps.rationale: Success criteria require a 60-minute response request; including what is expected in the update improves the likelihood of timely, useful information.
plan_steps.expected_outcome: A clearly stated deadline (“within 60 minutes”) directed to the incident lead, plus a brief description of the desired content of the update (queue verification results, retry backlog findings, and whether there is evidence of impact beyond the notification pipeline).

plan_steps.objective: Draft the full email with an appropriate sensitive tone, clear structure, and minimal but sufficient detail for action.
plan_steps.rationale: External communications during critical incidents should be concise, factual, and operationally oriented; the structure must help recipients quickly locate timeline, current status, requests, and deadlines.
plan_steps.expected_outcome: A complete email draft to the Acme Cloud operations team including: subject line indicating a sensitive EU incident, greeting, incident timeline/status paragraph, requested verification actions (delivery queues and retry backlog), unconfirmed scope question (extended impact beyond pipeline), and the 60-minute status update request to the incident lead, all without stating confirmed data loss or fully characterized impact beyond provided information.

plan_steps.objective: Sanitize wording for claims, confidence, and compliance with the “no confirmed data loss / no overreach” constraint.
plan_steps.rationale: High sensitivity requires careful language: avoid definitive statements where investigation is ongoing; ensure any uncertainty is explicit and consistent with the current understanding.
plan_steps.expected_outcome: Final wording that uses appropriate qualifiers (e.g., “intermittent,” “still investigating,” “no confirmed data loss,” “delayed processing for some EU tenants,” “confirm whether impact extended beyond…”), ensuring no accidental escalation of claims.

plan_steps.objective: Ensure the email contains all required elements and is ready for dispatch as an external incident notification.
plan_steps.rationale: Completeness and compliance with constraints are essential to meet success criteria; recipients must have all necessary context to act within the requested timeframe.
plan_steps.expected_outcome: A final, dispatch-ready email text that satisfies: timeline and current status clarity, explicit manual queue verification request, explicit retry backlog check request, confirmation request on extended customer-facing impact, and a 60-minute status update request to the incident lead, with sensitive-incident tone and accurate scope boundaries.
